EAL meanings

EAL most commonly means Evaluation Assurance Level in cybersecurity. Under the Common Criteria, levels EAL1 through EAL7 describe increasing rigor and depth in evaluating whether a product satisfies specified security requirements. It supports security certification, risk assessment, and product comparison. A higher EAL indicates more rigorous evaluation, not automatically stronger security.

Contextual ambiguity: In this conversation, EAL might instead be a platform-specific abbreviation for Enterprise Application Lifecycle. That interpretation could cover managing an application from idea through retirement, but the supplied context does not define EAL or identify the platform, so this meaning cannot be confirmed.
